# About Me

I'm Daniel, a Colombian **development economist** with **4+ years of experience** working at the intersection of **data and public policy**. My work centers on **human development and social protection**, especially health, early childhood and youth, and violence prevention. I have done most of it at the **IMAGINA Research Center** (Universidad de los Andes) and with the **Bogotá District Government**. I work in **Stata, R, Python, and SQL**, and I have used **large language models** to classify and summarize large volumes of policy documents.

Most of my work ends up with government teams and civil society organizations, so I put real effort into clean code and into documenting how each number was built. I'm finishing an M.A. in Economics at Los Andes.
